notes: v596 — THE WATCHDOG NO LONGER NEEDS ATTENTION TO WORK. v595's 150-second timeout only fired by being re-checked inside the 2-second heartbeat — and a backgrounded browser tab (a second window without focus) gets that repeating timer throttled hard by the browser, sometimes to once a minute or less, so the check could be starved and the display would freeze mid-count while real time kept passing (Tony: 'frozen @ 4sec but over 2 minutes so far'). The watchdog is now a genuine one-shot timer scheduled the instant checking begins — it fires on its own 150 seconds later regardless of whether anything else in that tab is running, and hands straight to the v587 self-heal. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5) on every open window.
